events.body: Load security incidents (parcels falling from a vehicle, doors opening in transit) are safety incidents. Raise them with Safety lead, Copperhythe Arc Logistics on the Safety incident queue straight away; they get the driver stopped. Damage to third-party property is then handled by Claims, Copperhythe Arc Logistics. Nobody on a desk accepts liability or agrees repair costs.

One of your vans just drove down Elm Parade with the back door swinging open and a box flew out, bounced off my car bonnet and landed about a foot from my son's pushchair. He's fine, thank god, but there's a proper dent. Van reg ended 61, it went off towards the high street with the door still flapping. I've got the box here, it's got a woman's name and address on it a few streets away, DL-2947. Shall I just drop it round to her? And who's paying for my bonnet, because I want that sorted this week.
